name: platform-discovery-2026-06-24
purpose: Public platform smoke sources for expanding Reflection King discovery coverage. These cases are inputs for evidence gathering, not claims that every platform is currently supported.

cases.name: youtube-bbb-external-video
cases.notes: Public Blender Foundation sample. Depends on configured external adapter and may fail on bot/token drift.

cases.name: soundcloud-nasa-public-audio
cases.notes: Public NASA audio sample through external adapter.

cases.name: bilibili-public-browser-video
cases.notes: Public Bilibili browser/API discovery sample; quality and availability may vary without a profile.

cases.name: acfun-public-external-video
cases.notes: Public AcFun sample for external adapter discovery.

cases.name: youku-public-trailer-video
cases.notes: Public Youku trailer sample. Signed HLS URLs may drift quickly; treat failures as evidence for adapter work.

cases.name: tiktok-public-external-video
cases.notes: Public short-video sample. Region/bot checks can change, so record outcome rather than assuming support.

cases.name: douyin-public-browser-video
cases.notes: Browser discovery sample for signed DOM/network media URLs; convert immediately if candidates appear.

cases.name: kuaishou-public-browser-video
cases.notes: Browser-only Kuaishou sample. CDN URLs are short-lived and should be converted immediately.

cases.name: vimeo-external-video
cases.notes: Public Vimeo sample used to verify external adapter and browser fallback coverage.

cases.name: ximalaya-public-audio
cases.notes: Public Ximalaya track sample. Lux explicitly lists Ximalaya audio support; RSS enclosure paths also provide stable browser-side evidence.

cases.name: weibo-public-video
cases.notes: Public Weibo video sample. Lux/yt-dlp support exists, but visitor redirect and anti-bot behavior can drift; record outcome rather than assuming success.

cases.name: apple-bipbop-hls-live-video
cases.notes: Long public HLS sample for manifest stress coverage; not expected in low-cost smoke.
